regime_context: The detector shows a narrow, defensive HK tape: Banks lead with a 1.32 score and 0.77 breadth but mean-revert hurst and crowded (z=1.02), while Energy (H-shares) is the only other eligible trend-led theme (hurst=trend, not crowded). Only 4 of 17 themes pass the absolute-trend gate, rotation is non-directional (absorption 0.45, no one-narrative), and the macro backdrop is dominated by AI-tech and geopolitics headlines with a full unscheduled-surprise share — a coincident risk-on noise layer, not a buy trigger. Given mean-revert leaders, narrow breadth, and crowded leadership, I give few directional leans and default to low conviction.
emerging_watch: Watching whether Energy (H-shares) can hold its trend tag and durability_bar above 0.60 while Banks (H + HK) mean-reverts — a confirmed handoff from Banks to Energy would retire this watch. If Banks' crowding_z rises above 1.5 while its score fades, the watch pivots to a non-directional cap.
